name: Road vehicle
author: aslnut
about: A road vehicle from its silhouette (wheelbase, overhangs, bonnet, windscreen rake, roof height and line, tail, clearance, wheels and arches, belt, glass, cladding, lamps), each type a row of those numbers (hatch, sedan, wagon, pickup, van, bus, truck, suv, crossover, tractor, citybus): a smooth body swept from its side profile, its glass wrapping round, head and tail lamps, a bed, a box or a trailer on a hinge at its fifth wheel; its paint tinted (one build for a fleet of colours), its glass, cladding and load groups; wheels, front doors and a trailer as parts, seats, grips and entries as anchors.
